blockingIssues.description: HF repo pulls with --bench pass a raw HF repo string into benchmark target resolution, but benchmark resolution accepts running tiers or catalog IDs, so arbitrary HF repo benchmarking fails.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify how strictly TDD-first ordering is enforced in review, or explicitly allow small implementation scaffolding before test additions when documenting required evidence.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Review for ungate-pull-command observed code edits in pull paths preceding the new HF repo tests, while the skill text says to write failing tests first.
